department: Department of Physics (Graduate School of Arts and Sciences)

deadline.value: PhD Physics: December 15 (year inferred; portal opens October 1). Physics MS has a separate Jan 15 / rolling-to-May 1 schedule.
deadline.quote: PhD | December 1 | Biology, Psychology, Chemistry | December 15 | Anthropology (not accepting applications this cycle), Art & Architectural History, Economics, English, History, Media Studies, Nursing, Physics, Politics, Religious Studies, French

gre_subject.value: Valid Physics GRE score required (self-reported at application; official scores needed on matriculation)
gre_subject.quote: Applicants to degree programs in Physics require a valid Physics GRE score; general GRE scores are not required.

supervisor.value: No supervisor is needed to apply; first-year students try preliminary research with several faculty and move to a dissertation advisor of their choice later.
supervisor.quote: A student may engage in several such preliminary research periods before embarking upon their dissertation research by which time they would transfer to a faculty advisor of their choice.

funding.value: Doctoral admits get at least five years of support: 12-month stipend $37,260, full tuition/fees remission, single health insurance
funding.quote: The Graduate School offers doctoral students a minimum of five years of financial support upon admission, including twelve-month living support of $37,260 and full remission of tuition, fees and the premium for single-person coverage

entry_route.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_general.value: General GRE not required for Physics
gre_general.quote: Applicants to degree programs in Physics require a valid Physics GRE score; general GRE scores are not required.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 in each section (department admissions page).
ielts_min.quote: The minimum IELTS score requirement is 7.0 in each section.
